evidence: 0x08021918 masks the id with 0xfff, maps ids at or above 716 to 0 and returns 0x08300000 + id * 20. The 20-byte descriptors are followed back to back by the animation tables (animation_count u32 script pointers each), the frame directories (packed; each runs to the next) and the (frame, ticks) animation scripts, which end where the first frame stream begins. Every frame directory belongs to a character or bank document; COMMON.JSON's regions list them in order.
